Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly reported "IMDb/knowledge panel shows the release as 1968 (USA)" for "Moment Of Danger," despite authoritative sources like IMDb and Wikipedia indicating its release year as 1960. This error arose because the agent failed to rigorously extract and validate release years across sources, causing confusion between different release regions and failing to recognize the earliest release year (1960 UK).
